const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""RoboLab episode controller for stack_yellow_on_red (eai-standard/2.2).
+
+Keep this process interactive so each move can be inspected before choosing the next.
+"""
+import os, sys, time, json
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+r = Robot()
+spec = r.spec()
+print("CONNECTED", r.status())
+print("PROPRIO_LAYOUT", spec.get("proprio_layout"))
+print("ACTION_TYPES", spec.get("action_types"))
+
+def snap(name="current", depth=True):
+    o = r.get_obs(depth=depth, video="frames")
+    os.makedirs("/app/output/observations", exist_ok=True)
+    for cam, im in o.last.items():
+        Image.fromarray(im).save(f"/app/output/observations/{name}_{cam}.jpg", quality=92)
+    if depth:
+        for cam, d in o.last_depth.items():
+            np.save(f"/app/output/observations/{name}_{cam}_depth.npy", d)
+    print("OBS", name, "status", r.status(), "now", o.meta.get("proprio", {}).get("now"))
+    return o
+
+def ee_rows(poses, video="mp4", note=""):
+    """Submit fingertip-centre poses [x,y,z,qw,qx,qy,qz,gripper]."""
+    res = r.submit("ee_pose", np.asarray(poses, dtype=np.float32), video=video, note=note)
+    print("RESULT", res.meta)
+    return res
+
+def joints_rows(rows, dt=1/15, video="mp4", note=""):
+    res = r.submit("joint_position", np.asarray(rows, dtype=np.float32), dt=dt, video=video, note=note)
+    print("RESULT", res.meta)
+    return res
+
+def save_res(res, name):
+    path = f"/app/output/observations/{name}"
+    res.save(path)
+    print("SAVED", path)
+
+obs = snap("initial", depth=True)
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(patch));

"""RoboLab episode controller for stack_yellow_on_red (eai-standard/2.2).

Keep this process interactive so each move can be inspected before choosing the next.
"""
import os, sys, time, json
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from rcb_client import Robot

r = Robot()
spec = r.spec()
print("CONNECTED", r.status())
print("PROPRIO_LAYOUT", spec.get("proprio_layout"))
print("ACTION_TYPES", spec.get("action_types"))

def snap(name="current", depth=True):
    o = r.get_obs(depth=depth, video="frames")
    os.makedirs("/app/output/observations", exist_ok=True)
    for cam, im in o.last.items():
        Image.fromarray(im).save(f"/app/output/observations/{name}_{cam}.jpg", quality=92)
    if depth:
        for cam, d in o.last_depth.items():
            np.save(f"/app/output/observations/{name}_{cam}_depth.npy", d)
    print("OBS", name, "status", r.status(), "now", o.meta.get("proprio", {}).get("now"))
    return o

def ee_rows(poses, video="mp4", note=""):
    """Submit fingertip-centre poses [x,y,z,qw,qx,qy,qz,gripper]."""
    res = r.submit("ee_pose", np.asarray(poses, dtype=np.float32), video=video, note=note)
    print("RESULT", res.meta)
    return res

def joints_rows(rows, dt=1/15, video="mp4", note=""):
    res = r.submit("joint_position", np.asarray(rows, dtype=np.float32), dt=dt, video=video, note=note)
    print("RESULT", res.meta)
    return res

def save_res(res, name):
    path = f"/app/output/observations/{name}"
    res.save(path)
    print("SAVED", path)

obs = snap("initial", depth=True)
